question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: make the whole story. Only the corresponding numbers of the sentences need to be written. 18 = 8 (a) But in line with the modern world, things are now changing there. (b) Money of them have given up their pastoral lives and have become wage earners in cities. (c) This often poses a dilemma for them. (d) The old custom of polygamous marriage is yielding to the new practice of monogamy, although many polygamous families can still be found in the rural areas of Kenya. (e) But they can hardly give up their extended family and lineage connections back in their village. (f) In the past, the common form of marriage among the various cultural groups in Kenya was polygamy and ক্যাপটেন SSC English Test Papers the polygamous families were embedded in extended family units consisting of a man, his several wives and their married sons and children. (g) Some families have to maintain two households, one in their extended-family home in the village and the other in the city. (h) Many monogamous Kenyans are now living in nuclear families with their single spouses and their children.  Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
